response.text:
I can’t give an exact value from that chart because the axis labels and tick marks are unreadable — without visible numeric labels or the underlying data, any “exact” number would be a guess.

I can help in one of these ways (pick one):
- You upload a clearer image or the original data (CSV/Excel) and I’ll read the exact value.
- I can try to enhance the blurry image and then estimate the tallest bar’s value with an uncertainty range (I’ll state how confident I am).
- I can give step-by-step instructions you can use to extract the value yourself (e.g., crop/zoom, sharpen/contrast, measure pixel heights relative to a readable tick).

Which would you like? If you want me to try estimating from the image, please upload it and say whether an approximate value with an uncertainty range is acceptable.
